event.prompt:
Update /workspaces/semio/semio/rs/lib.rs to support cohesive kit workflows for all five kit kinds using existing code.

Requirements:
1. Add high-level functions in existing non-wasm modules:
- import_file_kit(path: &str) -> Result<Kit>
- export_file_kit(kit: &Kit, path: &str) -> Result<()>
- import_folder_kit(folder_path: &str) -> Result<zip_roundtrip::KitImportResult>
- export_folder_kit(kit: &Kit, files: &std::collections::HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>, folder_path: &str) -> Result<()>
- import_remote_kit(url: &str) -> Result<zip_roundtrip::KitImportResult>
- edit_temporary_kit(kit: &Kit, diff: &KitDiff) -> Kit
- edit_file_kit(path: &str, diff: &KitDiff) -> Result<Kit>
- edit_folder_kit(folder_path: &str, diff: &KitDiff) -> Result<Kit>
- edit_archive_kit(path: &str, diff: &KitDiff) -> Result<Kit>
- edit_remote_kit(url: &str, diff: &KitDiff) -> Result<Kit>

2. Reuse existing logic:
- file kit uses serialize_kit/deserialize_kit
- folder kit uses sqlite::export_kit_to_sqlite/import_kit_from_sqlite plus filesystem asset read/write using std::fs and existing build_file_path
- archive kit uses zip_roundtrip::{import_kit_from_zip, export_kit_to_zip}
- remote kit should support remote JSON and remote ZIP. You may add reqwest blocking dependency in Cargo.toml if needed, but keep it minimal.
- temporary editing uses apply_kit_diff on a cloned Kit
- edit helpers import -> apply diff -> persist in place where applicable

3. Extend existing tests in lib.rs only. Add focused tests verifying file/folder/archive/remote/temporary workflows, using a tiny local HTTP server from std::net::TcpListener for remote JSON and ZIP.

4. Keep existing style and regions. Do not create new files. Run focused cargo test selectors and report exactly what passed.
